searchText: on the beacon-api events, are any CL teams notifying after validation of a block and before actually importing a block? what would you be setting the optimistic flag to under that circumstance? just chain head optimistic? Lighthouse waits for the block to be fully imported thats our current solution... as part of that we're running fork choice, so the 'weird' hting is you get the head update before the block event, and there's been a suggestion to 'fix' the order which im contemplating Yeah, makes sense. We've been told ours is "slow", but there's not much impetus to fix it, as AFAIK there's nothing critical relying on fast `block` events yeah the nice thing currently is the head update is fast artificially slowing it down to fix order would be a little hacky if the receiver wants that, they can always implement it themselves it seems like a pointless message in a lot of regards head has all of that info block would be useful for non-canonical blocks as they wouldn't generate a head event though. true, any non canonical. when i made it on validation, i got a bunch of old blocks get notified because they were still on the wire, which was a little interesting but maybe not super useful late blocks i guess, same theory
